about: Detector-relative compute axis for G2. Cost of one detector call at a native setting = measured mean detector latency (ms) on one CPU host (research/final/sci_v7f/G1_runtime/latency_curve_<det>.json: AMD EPYC 7763, 2 threads, 50 frames of uav0000086_00000_v, CUDA-free) divided by the latency at the reference setting 736 px. A reused frame (no detector call) costs 0. The controller sees only normalized costs, never native settings.
